properties.name: A1879/26 / LMMM
properties.originalText:
MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION.
ONGOING MILITARY ACTIVITY IN UKRAINE AND ALONG BORDER UKRAINE/RUSSIA 
AND USE OF A WIDE RANGE OF GROUND AND AIRBORNE WARFARE SYSTEMS WHICH 
POSES A HIGH RISK FOR CIVIL FLIGHTS OPERATING AT ALL ALTITUDES AND 
FLIGHT LEVELS. MALTESE REGISTERED AIR OPERATORS AND OWNERS OF 
AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN MALTA SHALL NOT ENTER UIR KYIV (UKBU), FIR 
LVIV (UKLV), FIR KYIV (UKBV), FIR DNIPROPETROVSK (UKDV), FIR 
SIMFEROPOL (UKFV), FIR ODESA (UKOV), FIR ROSTOV (URRV), FIR CHISINAU 
(LUUU) EXCEPT FOR THE PORTION OF AIRSPACE DESCRIBED IN NOTAMS AND 
RELATED AIP SUPPLIMENTS ISSUED BY THE REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA.OPERATIONS 
IN MINSK (UMMV) FIR ARE PROHIBITED UNDER EASA SD 2021-02 AND SD 
2021-03. 
OPERATORS ARE ADVISED TO FOLLOW ALSO RELEVANT CONFLICT ZONE 
INFORMATION BULLETIN (CZIB) ISSUED BY EASA AND AVOID FLIGHT 
OPERATIONS WITHIN THE BUFFER ZONE EXTENDING OUT TO 200NM ALONG THE 
UKRAINE/RUSSIA BORDER. ADDITIONAL RISK ASSESSMENT AND FLIGHT 
PLANNING DECISIONS SHALL BE TAKEN BEFORE OPERATING IN THE FOLLOWING 
AIRSPACE: MOSCOW (UUWV).
